supersedes: wave09-status.json for wave-10 facts (historical files retained). The old 'main has no context HTTP' conclusion is obsolete: main now serves POST /v1/context/preview.

phases.note: Removed the unconsumed confirmWithCommand helper (and ConfirmWithCommand types/plan_mismatch): the same effect id could return a different executable command. Main's planProposalCommand + commit + prepareCommand/commitPrepared remains the only confirmation authority; its command receipt covers the full command body. AssistantProposalService.commit now also requires the exact reviewed expectedDigest on confirmed replay. Tests migrated to the main path.

createScopedConversationProvider bounds paging and filters by project/conversation, trusted-user provenance, permission-display and system messages, and other-work anchors; coverage() exposes scanned/returned/complete plus exclusion counts. createPublishedArtifactProvider looks up only caller-verified published ids (metadata only, deduped, maxIds-bounded) and reports missing/complete. The old recommended recipe (global registry enumeration / unfiltered messages) is no longer used.

Manifest entries carry wholeSourceDigest, visiblePreviewDigest (included text) and digestScope alongside the compatible contentDigest; the manifest carries selection (project/conversation/work/contract) and coverage (complete/groups/omitted/truncated/budgetClamped). compareSourceManifests returns unchanged|changed|incomplete with content/preview/truncation/budget/selection/contract/missing/added/replaced; a same sourceId with another path is `replaced`, and an incomplete scan on either side is `incomplete`, never unchanged.

projectPromptData produces bounded untrusted reference text: item/UTF-8 byte/CJK-aware token caps with hard ceilings, per-item included-text digest, explicit truncation and omissions. No system role, tool, permission or command field; instruction-like content stays data; it sends no request and does not auto-attach.

Consumed main's real POST /v1/context/preview: 401 unauthenticated, 200 scoped sources with sourceDigest/previewDigest, foreign-project and permission-display messages excluded, decision present then absent after revoke, newly appended message visible, oversized caller budget clamped and reported, artifacts-without-work 400, recovery_readonly 422. Context-use (binding a selection to one message and calling the model) has no main HTTP yet: NOT_TESTED, owner main. C provides projectPromptData as its library input and wrote no HTTP/SQL/signature.

Four-package regression, old probes and the new adapter/manifest/prompt negatives are recorded; the historical wave-10 recipe probe cases are explicitly labelled fixed reproductions, not new-adapter certification.
